description:
Refactor the 'PhysicsCalc' project to eliminate magic numbers.

The project contains hard-coded numeric literals in four files:
- src/main/java/com/physicscalc/PhysicsConstants.java
- src/main/java/com/physicscalc/UnitConverter.java
- src/main/java/com/physicscalc/OrbitalMechanics.java
- src/main/java/com/physicscalc/NetworkConfig.java

Your task:
1. Open the 'PhysicsCalc' project in Eclipse.
2. In each file, identify the numeric literals (magic numbers).
3. Use Eclipse's 'Extract Constant' refactoring (Refactor > Extract Constant) to replace them with 'public static final' constants.
4. Use descriptive UPPER_SNAKE_CASE names for the constants (e.g., GRAVITY, SPEED_OF_LIGHT).
5. Ensure the project builds and all tests pass (Run As > JUnit Test).
